name: lee-techbot-md
description: LEE TECH WhatsApp automation bot with durable Heroku session storage

BOT_MODE.description: Bot access mode. Keep private until the owner configures the bot.

PAIRING_WEB_ENABLED.description: Serve the QR/pairing page automatically on the Heroku web URL.

AUTH_DIR.description: Ephemeral local cache; the durable S3-compatible store is the source of truth on Heroku.

AUTH_STORE.description: Enable durable S3-compatible WhatsApp auth storage.

S3_BUCKET.description: Private bucket used to persist the WhatsApp auth session across dyno replacement.

S3_REGION.description: S3 region; use auto for Cloudflare R2.

S3_PREFIX.description: Private object prefix for this bot's session. Use a unique prefix per bot.

S3_ENDPOINT.description: Optional S3-compatible endpoint. Leave empty for AWS S3; set the R2/B2/MinIO endpoint when applicable.

S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: Restricted S3-compatible access key with access only to the chosen auth prefix.

S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: Restricted S3-compatible secret key. Never commit or share this value.

S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE.description: Set true only when the S3-compatible provider requires path-style requests.

AUTH_STORE_DEBOUNCE_MS.description: Delay before coalesced auth updates are uploaded.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Owner WhatsApp number in international digits-only format, for example 254712345678.
